fields.Name: T217 - AI Configuration Section
fields.Description: Opens the AI app's Configuration section and verifies it renders.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K box). The AI app's LEFT nav lists sections: Overview, Agents, Agent Requests, Prompts, Models, MCP, Analytics, Configuration. Click the 'Configuration' section in the left nav. Verify the Configuration view renders — configuration settings/options/params, or a clearly-labeled empty state — with no error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI app's 'Configuration' section was opened
The Configuration view rendered (settings/options or a clear empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
